summary: Jupiter Neurosciences filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a definitive Strategic Asset License Agreement with PharmAla Biotech Holdings Inc. The agreement grants Jupiter an exclusive license to develop, manufacture and commercialize PharmAla's ALA-002 program in the United States. Consideration includes a $3.33 million upfront payment ($1.5M cash less escrow) plus potential milestones and royalties. This is an asset license, not a change-of-control transaction. No tender offer, merger, spin-off, activist campaign, or other special-situation category applies. The filing is a routine material definitive agreement entry under Item 1.01, not a special situation event.
